name: expense-api

dependencies.name: aws-s3
dependencies.description: Generates presigned upload/view URLs so receipt photos go directly to S3.

description: Owns expense claims and receipts: claim CRUD, employee submission, manager approval/rejection, presigned S3 URLs for receipt upload/view, and the team's weekly spending limit (read and set). Does not extract receipt data itself (the receipt-agent does), does not parse natural language into a limit itself (the limit-agent does), does not enforce the limit against a submission, and does not process reimbursement payment.
